name: Breeze Companion 0.3.0 — Web UI, models and voice updates
notes:
Breeze Companion now has a local browser UI for speech generation, reference editing and model management. It works on its own or alongside Home: Equestria through the existing TTS API.

### What is new

- **Generate:** search 139 voices, generate speech, play it automatically, cancel a request and download a WAV. Starting a new generation pauses the previous clip.
- **Voices:** the Reference Manager is integrated. Play the original recordings, inspect available source/provenance information, import and audition a replacement, then save or undo. Saved references immediately apply to the browser and API.
- **Models:** download, load, unload and delete pinned **F16, Q8, Q6, Q4, Q8 DD4, Q8 DD2 and Q4 DD2** variants. Downloads show progress, support cancellation and verify SHA-256. One model serves both the UI and API. Q8 remains the default; experimental variants are labeled separately.
- **Voice update:** reviewed `(gasp)` / `(giggles)` cue handling and the new slow-trained Pinkie Pie LoRA, using a matching 0.8× reference and automatic 1.25× output playback. The new archive includes all 139 playable reference recordings and six Mane Six adapters.

### Download and start

Download **one companion archive plus the shared voice archive**:

| Platform | Companion archive |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x86_64 | `breeze-tts-pny-0.3.0-windows-x86_64.zip` |
| Linux x86_64 | `breeze-tts-pny-server-0.3.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |

Both need `breeze-pny-curated-voices-20261115.tar.gz`. Keep the voice archive compressed and place it inside or beside the extracted companion folder.

- **Windows:** run `setup.cmd`, then `breeze-companion.cmd`. Python and the native runtime are included.
- **Linux:** follow [Linux setup](https://github.com/ponywizard/breeze-tts-pny/blob/v0.3.0/docs/SERVER.md#install), then run the installed `bin/breeze-pny serve --web`. Python 3.11+ and the documented Vulkan/system dependencies are required.

The browser uses port **18793** and the API uses **18792** by default. Use the complete session link printed by the launcher. `--web-port` changes the UI port; `--port` changes the API port. Existing services or SSH tunnels must not occupy those ports. API-only use remains available with `start-companion.cmd` or `serve` without `--web`.

The game is optional. Home: Equestria users keep **game mod 0.1.3**, compatible with game **0.3.1.2-maredev**. Both platform game packs are attached; the Windows ZIP also includes its pack. The native runtime remains the patched 0.1.6 build.

### Upgrade from companion 0.2.1

Stop the existing companion, extract the new archive, supply the new voice archive, and run setup with `--update` against the existing installation. The installer preserves the selected supported model, host/ports, automatic-loading preference and compatible personal references. Verified model files are reused. No separate Reference Manager download is needed.

A personal Pinkie reference saved with the older playback profile needs re-registration and auditioning against the new profile. Setup refuses that incompatible migration before replacing the active configuration. See the [Companion guide](https://github.com/ponywizard/breeze-tts-pny/blob/v0.3.0/docs/COMPANION.md#upgrade-from-021) for the migration steps.

### Validation and Windows testing

- The maintainer tested generation, voice selection and playback in the Linux browser UI.
- The 69-test Python suite passed on Linux and Windows embedded Python under Wine (five expected Windows skips). Chromium checks cover generation/autoplay/download, same-text voice switching, cancellation, references/provenance, model controls, reload and mobile layout.
- All seven models passed Linux Vulkan checks on an RX 6700 XT, including all six adapters, a base voice, reference preview, unloading, and verification of all 139 voice caches. Fresh Linux and Windows/Wine installations passed setup and `doctor`.
- **Native Windows browser/GPU and game/VR testing is left to Windows users.** Wine checks do not establish native Windows compatibility. No new in-game or VR playtest is claimed for this companion update. Include versions, GPU/driver and matching logs when reporting issues.

Model download sizes are not total VRAM requirements. Experimental depth-decoder models may lose quality on long speech. Full validation details and limits are in [SERVER_VALIDATION.md](https://github.com/ponywizard/breeze-tts-pny/blob/v0.3.0/docs/SERVER_VALIDATION.md).

`SHA256SUMS`, build receipts and `RELEASE-MANIFEST.json` identify the published files and source commit. Model weights are downloaded during setup or through Models; they are not embedded in the companion archives.
